text: Discuss the ways in which the extract constructs meaning through the following:
• camera shots, angles, movement and composition
• editing
• sound
• mise-en-scène. [50]
Section B: Institutions and audiences
Answer one question from this section.
Refer to specific examples from one media area chosen from:
• film
• music
• print
• radio
• video games.
In relation to the media area you have studied, discuss the ways audience consumption has
changed over time. [50]
OR
To what extent is digital distribution vital to the media area you have studied? [50]
